meta.name: taltempla-toolshed-packages
meta.status: proposal: names checked against PyPI; versions not pinned; the wheel set resolves together (see resolve_check)
rules: Python only: a tool is one Python file (D21). System packages exist only to support Python packages.
No GPU. Install torch, torchvision and torchaudio from https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu.
No version pins yet. Run uv lock after the first successful image build.
heavy = large install or slow to build. Put heavy packages in a separate image layer, or install them on demand.
source_build = no wheel on PyPI for 3.13 x86_64. It builds on install.
A package can appear in more than one category. Install each name once.

reason_needs_key_or_account: third-party SDKs that need a key: PR-14 (key injection) comes later. elevenlabs is listed for the side challenge only.

resolve_check.target: python 3.13, x86_64 linux, --only-binary :all:, torch from the CPU index
resolve_check.excluded_from_check: every package with source_build (35): they build from source on install
resolve_check.note: torch resolved to the +cpu build. xgboost drags in nvidia-nccl-cu13 (unused without a GPU, large); drop it from the image with uv pip uninstall or use xgboost-cpu.
